title: Students protest at Ministry of Education in Rome

tea.why: Students are protesting against school conditions, government rearmament policies, and the Minister of Education, Giuseppe Valditara.
tea.want: The protesters are demanding changes to government education and rearmament policies.
tea.changed: Nov 20: Protesters threw firecrackers, glass bottles, and other objects at the Ministry of Education building on Viale Trastevere.

summary: On November 20, 2026, thousands of high school and university students marched in Rome as part of a broader Europe-wide protest. The demonstration reached the Ministry of Education on Viale Trastevere, where some participants threw firecrackers, glass bottles, helmets, and a road sign at the building. The area was secured by law enforcement during the event. Protesters chanted slogans directed against the Minister of Education, Giuseppe Valditara. While some participants engaged in throwing objects, others attempted to de-escalate the situation, with one student sitting on the ministry steps to discourage the violence. No official government response regarding the specific demands or the actions at the ministry has been reported in the provided sources.
response: No official response reported in the sources.

crowd.text: La Repubblica reported thousands of high school and university students were present.

updates.text: Students marched to the Ministry of Education in Rome, throwing firecrackers and bottles at the building.
